preconditions.description: The input string s has a length between 1 and 99, inclusive.
The length of s is divisible by 3, ensuring it is a multiple of the SOS message length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in s are uppercase English letters (A-Z).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(s)) if s[i] != 'SOS'[i % 3])
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the count of characters in s that differ from the expected SOS message pattern, where the pattern repeats every 3 characters ('S', 'O', 'S').
